properties.can-change-guardian: If an address `a` has behaved as a guardian, it might not behave as a guardian now.
properties.can-change-guardian-variable: If an address `a` was in the guardian list, it might not be in the guardian list now.
properties.can-change-owner: If an address `a` has behaved as an owner, it might not behave as an owner now.
properties.can-change-owner-variable: The value of the variable `owner` can change.
properties.recov-can-cancel: If a call to `cancelRecovery()` is followed by `executeRecovery()` with no in-between calls, if an address `a` behaved as the owner before `executeRecovery()` then it must behave as the owner immediately afterwards.
properties.recov-can-cancel-variable: If a call to `cancelRecovery()` is followed by `executeRecovery()` with no in-between calls, the content of the variable `owner` before `executeRecovery()`must be the same as its content immediately afterwards.
properties.recov-can-happen: If `supportRecovery()` was called successfully at least the number of times specified by the `threshold` parameter of the constructor and `cancelRecovery()` wasn't called, then the address that behaves as the owner must be different before and after the call to `executeRecovery()`.
properties.recov-can-happen-variable: If `supportingGuardianCount` for the current round is at least `guardianThreshold` and the contract is in the `inRecovery` state, then the content of the `owner` variable must be different before and after the call to `executeRecovery()`.
properties.removal-requires-owner: Guardian behavior changes if owner behavior.
properties.removal-requires-owner-variable: Guardian list changes if owner variable.
